response.justification: Bogdan has strong backend and distributed-systems expertise, including real-time systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby), and recent AI-agent work at re:cinq. However, he lacks direct fintech or credit-risk experience, and his leadership scale is unproven at the 10-30+ team level. His resume shows versatility across domains but no clear track record in regulated commercial environments or agentic AI at scale.
strengths: Strong distributed-systems and real-time backend experience (e.g., Dunnhumby, GISCollective).
Recent hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (re:cinq).
Proven ability to architect event-driven systems and scale applications (e.g., GISCollective, Optilyz).
concerns: No fintech or credit-risk infrastructure experience, a core requirement for the role.
Lacks demonstrated experience scaling engineering teams to 10-30+ people in a leadership capacity.
Limited evidence of operating AI systems in regulated or high-stakes commercial environments.
